"those who cannot log in, please follow these steps. i hope its worth sharing. for new user: 1). go to your home branch and ask for the cif number. 2). enter the cif number and select the activation process through bank. 3). ask your home branch to activate your account for mobile banking and wait for one time password. then, enter the one time password and set up your username, mpin, and transaction pin/password. boom!! your are in. for old user: 1). reinstall 2). enter cif number again. 3). select through debit card. 4). wait for one time password at your registered mobile number. enter the one time password and you would be able to log in using your old username and mpin. and there you go. i hope, this would help you. :)"
